persona.philosophy: Fusion over Imitation. Emotion First. Content is King.

headings.usage: All headers (h1-h6). Use tracking-tight for large text.

buttons.primary: bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 text-white font-medium shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(37,99,235,0.4)] transition-all duration-300 hover:scale-[1.02]
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-slate-700 hover:border-slate-500 text-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-800/50

cards.default: bg-slate-900/50 border border-slate-800/60 backdrop-blur-sm rounded-xl p-6 hover:border-slate-700/80 transition-colors
cards.interactive: group relative overflow-hidden bg-slate-900/40 border border-slate-800 hover:border-blue-500/30 transition-all duration-300

inputs.style: bg-slate-950/50 border-slate-800 focus:border-blue-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-500/50 placeholder:text-slate-600 text-slate-200

map.container_style: w-full h-full rounded-xl overflow-hidden border border-slate-800 shadow-2xl relative z-0
map.markers: Use custom SVG icons. Blue for standard members, Gold for board members.

global.spacing: Generous. Use p-6 or p-8 for containers. Gap-6 for grids.

dashboard.grid: Bento Grid. Mix of col-span-1, col-span-2, and row-span-2 cards.
dashboard.sidebar: Fixed left, w-64, glassmorphism style. Collapsible on mobile.

login_page.style: Split screen or Centered Glass Card.
login_page.background: Deep dark void with subtle blue/gold mesh gradient or the provided network image with heavy overlay.

instructions_to_main_agent: 2. FONTS: Import 'Outfit' and 'DM Sans' from Google Fonts in index.css.
3. THEME: Configure tailwind.config.js to use the 'Obsidian' palette defined in design_system.colors.
4. MAP: Implement the Leaflet map in the 'Mappa' tab. Use the CSS filter hack for dark mode. Fetch the GeoJSON for regions.
5. COMPONENTS: Customize Shadcn components. Remove the default 'radius' variable reliance if it conflicts with the 'rounded-xl' strategy.
6. LOGIN: Hardcode credentials (user: DigitalTwin26, pass: Dgt_26$).
7. DATA: Mock the member data for the CRUD interface if backend is not ready, but structure it for MongoDB.
8. CRITICAL: Ensure all text has sufficient contrast against the dark background. Use 'text-slate-400' for labels, 'text-slate-100' for values.
universal_guidelines: Do not use gradients for text unless it is a very large headline.
Always add hover states to interactive elements.
Ensure the map container has a defined height (e.g., h-[600px] or h-[calc(100vh-200px)]).
